name: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun
summary: Seeking an explosive countermeasure against the Venture Company's logging machines in the Stonetalon Mountains, Alliance adventurers are sent across the sea to Ironforge. There, the eccentric gnome Lomac Gearstrip agrees to brew his volatile invention, Nitromirglyceronium, provided you fetch the necessary alchemical reagents.

sections.title: A Volatile Solution
sections.body: Gaxim Rustfizzle, stationed high in the craggy passes of the Stonetalon Mountains, found himself completely stymied by the sheer bulk and armor of goblin shredders. Rather than relying on simple steel or standard siege tactics, he turned to an eccentric former colleague living in Ironforge: Lomac Gearstrip. Lomac is the creator of Nitromirglyceronium, a substance so inherently unstable and destructive that he finds the prospect of anyone using it hilarious, regardless of who gets blown apart in the process.

sections.title: Potions for Pyrotechnics
sections.body: Despite Lomac's eagerness to see goblin machinery—and possibly the adventurer—blown into pieces, his workshop in Ironforge is entirely out of the finished compound. Before he will brew a fresh batch of Nitromirglyceronium, Lomac demands common alchemical draughts: Minor Mana Potions and Elixirs of Minor Fortitude. In his eyes, forcing an adventurer to gather these ingredients serves a dual purpose, ensuring he has the raw reagents needed for the reaction while proving they possess at least a shred of respect for the craft of alchemy.

faq.answer: Lomac Gearstrip is an eccentric gnomish alchemist and tinkerer located in the dwarven capital of Ironforge. He is an old colleague of Gaxim Rustfizzle and the inventor of Nitromirglyceronium, an extraordinarily volatile explosive compound.

faq.q: Why does Lomac want potions instead of standard engineering parts?
faq.answer: Lomac utilizes alchemy alongside his mechanical know-how to produce high-grade volatile reactions. The magical energy of Minor Mana Potions and the stabilizing bodily humors enhanced by Elixirs of Minor Fortitude serve as base reagents for his specialized Nitromirglyceronium mixture.

faq.q: Why send an adventurer all the way to Ironforge for this?
faq.answer: Gaxim Rustfizzle is isolated in the wilds of Stonetalon without access to heavy industrial or chemical workshops. Lomac Gearstrip in Ironforge is the only associate he trusts—or fears enough—to possess an explosive potent enough to crack Venture Company machinery.

Nitromirglyceronium is Lomac Gearstrip's proprietary explosive chemical brew. It is notoriously volatile, formulated specifically to generate enough concussive blast force to tear apart heavily fortified mechanical equipment.

faq.q: Is Lomac worried about the Venture Company or the forest?
faq.answer: Not in the slightest. Lomac openly laughs at the idea of using high explosives to save trees. His sole interest in handing over the compound is the chaotic prospect of watching either the goblins or the courier get blasted to pieces.

faq.q: Do you need to be an alchemist to complete this task?
faq.answer: No. While Lomac talks about testing your alchemical mettle, he accepts reagents acquired through trade, merchants, or other crafters just the same, so long as he gets the draughts required for his recipe.

angles.text: Lomac represents the unrestrained, madcap fringe of gnomish ingenuity, prioritizing sheer chemical yield and theoretical application over safety or diplomatic caution.
The long trek from Stonetalon to Ironforge highlights the logistical strain of supporting remote Alliance outposts scattered throughout hostile Kalimdor.
Where standard blasting powder fails against Venture Company steel, combining esoteric alchemy with engineering principles produces far more catastrophic results.
